drafter.private_reasoning: The client’s confidential $13,000,000 minimum is not disclosed or used as an offer. The draft is improved with a clear price placeholder and practical, seller-protective closing, representation, and indemnity language, while flagging price as an open business term.

edits.text: 3. REPRESENTATIONS. edits.name: Representations

edits.text: 4. INDEMNITY. Seller shall indemnify Buyer for direct losses finally awarded by a court or agreed in a written settlement, to the extent arising from Seller’s breach of an express representation or covenant in this Agreement. Buyer shall give prompt written notice of a claim and permit Seller to participate in its defense; no settlement imposing liability or non-monetary obligations on Seller may be entered without Seller’s consent, not to be unreasonably withheld. Seller shall have no liability for a claim unless aggregate covered losses exceed USD $[●], and Seller’s aggregate liability shall not exceed [●]% of the Purchase Price, except in cases of fraud or intentional misrepresentation. Claims for breach of representations must be brought within twelve (12) months after Closing. There shall be no recovery for consequential, punitive, or duplicative damages.

drafter.message_to_opposing_counsel: Seller’s preliminary price expectation is USD 16,500,000, subject to diligence and the agreed terms of the transaction. That expectation reflects Seller’s assessment of the business as a going concern, including its operating performance and prospects; Seller can provide supporting financial information through the diligence process. The proposed agreement already limits indemnity to direct losses for express breaches and includes notice, defense, time, and damages limitations. Seller proposes a USD 100,000 aggregate-loss threshold and a cap of 10% of the Purchase Price, subject to the stated fraud and intentional-misrepresentation exception. Please share Buyer’s proposed price range and any specific revisions to the representation and indemnity limitations so the parties can focus diligence and negotiation efficiently.
